title: iMS GTM Intelligence Lead Contract v1
description: Unified Lead contract for qualification, enrichment, orchestration, and engagement stages. Designed to be additive on top of industrial/municipal radar schemas, not replace them. Supports backward-compatible legacy lead IDs and evidence-first architecture.

contract_version.description: Version of this contract. Enables additive evolution to v2, v3, etc.

lead_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this lead. Recommended formats: IND-YYYYMMDD-NNN (industrial, 3-digit suffix), IND-YYYYMMDD-NN (2-digit, legacy 2026-08-20 batch), OP-YYYYMMDD-NNN or ML-YYYYMMDD-NNNN (municipal), or H-N (agent-sourced). Format conformance is a validator WARNING, never a schema-level error, to preserve backward compatibility with existing IDs.

vertical.description: Which market vertical this lead belongs to. Closed enum; adding a vertical is a deliberate schema change.

pipeline_stage.description: Current stage in the GTM pipeline. Transitions are governed by pipeline_history and validator rules (not expressible as a pure JSON Schema constraint). See docs/PIPELINE.md for the transition graph.

company.description: Company/account name. May be 'UNKNOWN' if genuinely not determinable.

source.description: Traceability: where this Lead was derived from (which legacy radar file and signal/opportunity ID).

evidence.description: Core evidence supporting this lead: facts (confirmed), inferences (AI-derived), unknowns (deliberately unresolved). Matches existing industrial schema exactly.

pipeline_history.description: Append-only log of how this Lead reached its current pipeline_stage. Must have at least one entry (the initial RADAR entry). Used by the validator to check for valid state transitions.

qualification.description: Qualification-stage decision. Conditionally required (required if pipeline_stage >= QUALIFICATION, enforced by the root-level allOf/if/then below). Stores only the *decision* (PASS/REVIEW/REJECT), not the *mechanism* for reaching it — scoring model design is out of scope for Week 1.

enrichment.description: Enrichment-stage intelligence: company, project, EPC/design-institute ecosystem, contacts, missing roles. Conditionally required (required if pipeline_stage >= ENRICHMENT, enforced by the root-level allOf/if/then below).

provenance.description: General audit log of actor/action/timestamp. Distinct from pipeline_history (which tracks stage transitions). Optional; use for recording enrichment contributions, human reviews, system updates.

sales_feedback.description: Sales engagement outcome, filled in after ENGAGEMENT stage. Optional; never required even at ENGAGEMENT — captures feedback when available.

possible_duplicate.description: Flag indicating this lead may be a duplicate of another (set during orchestration/dedup pass). Precedent: industrial enriched contacts have this field.

duplicate_of.description: If possible_duplicate is true, the lead_id of the canonical lead this is a duplicate of.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this Lead was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this Lead was last updated.

extensions.description: Sanctioned escape hatch for experimental or vertical-specific fields. Contents here are unvalidated by the schema and not part of the official contract. Use this instead of forking the schema.

allOf.description: qualification is required once pipeline_stage has advanced past RADAR/QUALIFICATION-in-progress.
enrichment is required once pipeline_stage has reached ENRICHMENT or later.

vertical.description: Radar vertical (industrial/municipal) where this lead was sourced.

source_report_id.description: report_id from the source radar file (e.g., 'ind-radar-20260821', 'radar-20260821').

source_signal_id.description: Lead/signal/opportunity ID from the source radar file (e.g., 'IND-20260821-001', 'OP-20260821-005').

source_file.description: Optional: relative path to the source radar file (e.g., 'intelligence/industrial/daily/ind_2026-08-21.json').

retrieved_at.description: Optional: timestamp when this Lead was extracted from the source file.

facts.description: Confirmed facts about the opportunity. May be empty if no facts yet confirmed.

inferences.description: AI-derived inferences from available sources. May be empty.

unknowns.description: Explicitly unresolved questions or missing information. Preferred over fabricating data.

items.description: Optional: richer structured evidence with source/agent/confidence metadata per item. Can coexist with facts/inferences/unknowns.

source_agent.description: Optional: which Cloud Agent or AI system contributed this (e.g., 'DuMate', 'Claude').

date.description: Optional: when this evidence was collected/discovered.

confidence.description: Optional: confidence level in this evidence item.

decision.description: The qualification decision: PASS (qualified for enrichment), REVIEW (needs manual review or reassessment), REJECT (disqualified).

decided_by.description: Who/what made the decision (agent name, username, system identifier).

reason.description: Explanation for the decision. Required if decision is REJECT.

status.description: Current enrichment status. AGENT_DISCOVERED: lead was sourced directly by an agent outside the main pipeline (e.g., direct agent exploration, may have minimal structured fields).

project_intelligence.description: One or more projects associated with this lead.

organization_relationships.description: EPC, design institute, owner organizational relationships.

contacts.description: Contacts discovered for this lead (owner-side, EPC-side, design-side roles).

missing_roles.description: Roles/positions still needed but not yet discovered.

enrichment_sources.description: Tools/sources used during enrichment (e.g., 'DuMate', 'enterprise registry', 'field visit').

agent_contributions.description: Which agents contributed to this enrichment and what they added.

aliases.description: Other names by which this company is known.

industry.description: Industry classification (free text; no unified taxonomy yet).

location.description: Company headquarters or main facility location.

water_system_ownership.description: Indicates whether the company owns its own water treatment system (A=yes, clear ownership; B=possible; C=unlikely; D=no; N/A=not applicable).

project_id.description: Unique project identifier within the lead (e.g., 'PRJ-IND-20260821-001-01').

status.description: Current project stage (free text; each vertical may use different vocabularies). Examples: 'Planning', '设计阶段', 'Tender', '已建成运营'.

normalized_stage.description: Optional: an attempt to normalize the free-text status into a common vocabulary. Left unpopulated by default since municipal and industrial use different native stage vocabularies — future decision whether to compute this.

estimated_time_window.description: Expected project timeline or phase start/end.

source_lead_ids.description: If this project is suspected to be a duplicate of another discovered via different lead(s), reference the other lead_ids here.

relationship_id.description: Unique identifier for this organizational relationship (e.g., 'ORG-IND-20260821-001-01').

project_id.description: Which project this relationship maps to.

owner.description: Roles on the owner/client side (e.g., project manager, EHS, water treatment, procurement).

epc.description: Roles on the EPC contractor side.

design_institute.description: Roles at the design institute (if separate entity).

other.description: Other stakeholders (system integrators, component suppliers, etc.).

role_exists.description: Does this role exist in this organizational context?

role_title.description: Title of the role (e.g., 'Project Manager', '水处理主管', 'EHS Director').

person.description: Name of the person holding this role, or 'UNKNOWN' if role exists but person is not yet identified.

contact_id.description: Reference to the contact object if this person is in the contacts[] array.

organization_name.description: Name of the organization (owner/EPC/design institute) this role belongs to.

name.description: Full name. May be 'UNKNOWN' if role is confirmed but person is not yet identified.

role.description: Classification of this contact's role in the buying process. A=decision-maker/budget holder; B=project influencer; C=information gatekeeper; D=account context/observer.

evidence_score.description: How confident we are in the accuracy of this contact's information (0-100).

commercial_relevance_score.description: How relevant this contact is to the commercial opportunity (0-100).

discovered_by.description: Which Cloud Agent(s) discovered this contact. Mandatory array (v1 normalizes the legacy string/array inconsistency across verticals to always be an array).

sources.description: Source tools/databases where this contact was found (e.g., 'DuMate', 'BOSS直聘', '企查查').

evidence.description: Structured evidence supporting this contact (same as lead-level evidence).

human_verified.description: Has a human confirmed the accuracy of this contact?

verified_by.description: Who verified this contact (username or agent name).

cross_agent_confirmation.description: Has this contact been independently discovered by multiple agents?

possible_duplicate.description: Is this contact a possible duplicate of another contact?

conflict_note.description: If there are conflicting details about this person (e.g., different titles from different sources), note them here rather than auto-resolving.

value.description: The actual contact value (phone number or email address).

verified.description: Has this specific channel been verified as working?

agent_name.description: Name of the Cloud Agent or AI system (e.g., 'DuMate', 'Claude', 'Perplexity').

contributed_fields.description: Which enrichment fields this agent contributed to (e.g., ['contacts', 'company_intelligence']).

record_count.description: How many records (contacts, projects, etc.) this agent added.

actor.description: Who/what performed the action (agent name, username, system).

action.description: What action was performed (free text, e.g., 'enriched contacts', 'verified company name', 'qualified PASS').

notes.description: Optional: reason or context for the transition.

feedback_notes.description: Why the outcome occurred, or notes for future efforts.

next_step.description: Recommended next action if outcome is IN_PROGRESS or LOST but reachable.
